author: VoxCruda
quote: GTA used to be about chaos, controversy, dark humor and unapologetic anarchy. Now it feels like the morality department took over game development. Less freedom, restricted interactions, questionable limitations, and a story that seems to revolve around keeping Lucia happy. Instead of fearless social satire, we get what feels like a digital etiquette class. Rockstar, I came here to play GTA, not attend a mandatory course in social conditioning.
